second_order.action: inline the shared DTD subset into every installed command
second_order.effect: each invocation carries the subset's tokens
a command survives a moved or missing dtd directory
authors grow the subset and every command pays
a size cap on the subset becomes a rule
second_order.loop: growth raises cost until the cap pushes back
second_order.delayed: the cost is invisible until the subset is large
second_order.assessment: self-containment outweighs the token cost while the subset stays under about 1.5 KB
